description: A science show preforms two different demonstrations, demonstration 1 and demonstration 2. In demonstration 1, 10 units of mint and 20 units of the active ingredient is used to make 25 units of minty foam. In demonstration 2, 12 units of mint and 15 units of the active ingredient is used to make 18 units of minty foam. In addition, demonstration 1 creates 5 units of black tar while demonstration 2 creates 3 units of black tar. The show has available 120 units of mint and 100 units of active ingredients. If at most 50 units of black tar can be produced, how many of each demonstration should be done to maximize the amount of minty foam produced?

MintUsed.definition: Amount of mint used by each demonstration

ActiveIngredientUsed.definition: Amount of active ingredient used by each demonstration

FoamProduced.definition: Amount of minty foam produced by each demonstration

BlackTarProduced.definition: Amount of black tar produced by each demonstration

TotalActiveIngredientAvailable.definition: Total units of active ingredient available

MaxBlackTarAllowed.definition: Maximum units of black tar allowed

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total amount of minty foam produced from the two demonstrations"

constraints.description: 20 * (number of demonstration 1) + 15 * (number of demonstration 2) should not exceed TotalActiveIngredientAvailable
Number of demonstration 1 should be greater than or equal to 0
Number of demonstration 2 should be greater than or equal to 0

NumDemos.definition: Number of times each demonstration is performed
